name: Shovel of Yorgrim

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Maidenmist Cemetery; the book's numbers, our words.

powers.name: Death-Kenning
powers.text: After the shovel hits an Undead this turn, learn its Resistances, Immunities and traits.

summary: A gravedigger's shovel as heavy as a greatclub (+1, +2 at level 7, +3 at 13): Death-Kenning (a Bonus Action after hitting an Undead learns its defences), Gentle Repose and Speak with Dead once a dusk each. From level 7, Deny Death's Touch: its bearer and allies within 10 ft resist Necrotic damage.
